Name: SageFelix - RRRR Old ver. Wizard Magnus Rasmodius Portraits
Author: SageFelix
Description:
[center][size=6]A new look for our handsome wizard.[/size][/center]
[size=3]Thank you so much for your patience y'all![/size]
[center][size=3][b]SAGE, WHERE WERE YOU??????
[/b][/size]Sorry, college and work had me locked up with no motivation, I'm trying my best.[/center]
[size=4][i][u]What to expect from this mod?[/u][/i]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]This mod changes the look of the wizard to a more handsome version of him, his outfits are based on [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15867]the other[/url]﻿ younger portrait mod that I made. These portraits are ONLY COMPATIBLE WITH [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]﻿﻿ MOD, NO SVE OR VANILLA AVAILABLE FOR THE MOMENT (I will eventually). [/size]
[/list][u][size=4]What are the requirements for this mod to work?
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Aside from the RRRR mod, it requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture [/url]﻿﻿to work.
[/list]

[u][size=4]But Sage, the mod is made for HD Portraits, why does it need Portraiture?
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]I tried making the mod pack using the portraiture format, but honestly, I'm used to the HD Portrait format so I kept it like that. That way I could have everything in one carpet instead of doing a separate carpet for the portraits. Once you are inside the game just [b]press [P] [/b]and the portraits should show.[/size]
[size=3]
[b]YOU DON'T HAVE TO MOVE ANYTHING TO PORTRAITURE FOLDERS!!! JUST INSTALL THIS MOD LIKE ANY OTHER!! [/b][/size][size=4][u]
[/u][/size][/list][size=4][u]Where's his hat?[/u]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Because his sprites are bigger than the previous design the hat was going over the sprite sheet, so I decided to take it out. Sorry hat lovers...[/size]
[font=Courier New][size=5][center][/center][/size][/font][/list]
